census.description: Protected census input (the gate’s region_enslaved_population): read only by the derived self-emancipation term, never written, counted or spent by any seat. Rows only where a source gives it.

practices.description: His own standing practices (lane 1.5b), each cited: conduct an order of the map can run against (a row’s clashes), such as a commander’s practice toward fugitives. Gate content.

regard.description: His regard for his own faction’s principal at the pack’s first start, a cited centre (lane 1.1).

regardOthers.description: His regard for other people at the pack’s first start (lane 1.5: rivals, partners), each a cited direction.

temperament.description: Boldness and candour (lane 1.1): cited centres history’s shadow draws around at setup.

values.description: The values he holds, from the pack’s values vocabulary, each cited (lane 1.1); empty when none is known.

combat.description: The battle model (lane 1.3; the combat note): design parameters the pack states (0072), not sourced facts; the starting values sit inside Livermore’s and Fox’s bands.

baseRates.description: K+W per 1000 men in contact per day, by battle type, for the side that attacks and the side that defends (P2).

capturedPermille.description: Of the missing, permille captured on the field, by result.

commit.description: Per dawn commit: the share of men committed, and the posture term both sides take.

decisions.description: The commanders’ rules (P6), read against his own demand ratio: shares are permille of it.

fieldControlPermille.description: Control the side left holding the field gains, permille (P9).

killedPermille.description: Killed, permille of killed and wounded.

leaders.description: A commander’s draw per battle-day on his own stream: killed, wounded, captured (only if his side routs).

maxBattleDays.description: A battle closes after this many days (P1).

missingPermille.description: Missing, permille of K+W, by the side’s result.

otherTerrain.description: The row for any terrain the table does not name (the pack’s statement, never a kernel default).

phases.description: The day shape (P10): each phase’s hours, and each battle type’s share of the day’s losses per phase.

pursuit.description: Pursuit’s captures (lane 1.4): the pursued side’s stragglers taken on a rearguard day, by the pursuer’s choice, more with cavalry.

straggleReturnPermille.description: Stragglers who rejoin a day, permille of the pool (P8).

terms.description: The additive loss terms’ weights and caps (P4).

terrain.description: Per terrain the pack names: men who can be in contact per side per day (P3), and a loss term both sides take.

works.description: Region fortification (permille) at or above which a defender is dug in or in works.

latency.description: How long each route takes beside the map’s courier days (0026, 0032): design parameters the pack states, not sourced facts.

courierNoiseMaxDays.description: The most extra days a courier or the mail can lose to roads and weather. A design parameter.

mailPermille.description: The mail against a courier, permille (slower: above 1000). A design parameter.

specialMessengerPermille.description: A special messenger against a courier, permille (faster: at most 1000). A design parameter.

specialMessengerPrice.description: The attention a special messenger costs its sender. A design parameter.

wireDays.description: Days for a message on the wire between two wired regions. A design parameter.

movement.description: Movement and messages over the graph (0064): design parameters the pack states, not sourced facts.

courierPermille.description: A courier’s days on an edge, permille of a division’s, rounded up, at least one day. A design parameter.

marchMinCapacityPermille.description: The least capacity an edge needs this month to carry a march, permille of one unit of the capacity scale; at most capacityMax x 1000. A design parameter.

occupation.description: Occupation (0064): a side alone that marched in takes ground by its men. Design parameters the pack states, not sourced facts.

occupyFullMen.description: The men at which occupation reaches its full rate; fewer gain in proportion. A design parameter.

occupyPermille.description: Control a side alone in held ground gains a day at full strength, permille. A design parameter.

operations.description: Operations (lane 1.4): design parameters the pack states (0072), not sourced facts.

holdControlPermille.description: Control at its objective at which an axis holds it and its operation ends.

maxRepulses.description: Times an axis may be driven back before its operation fails. A design parameter.

pauseDays.description: Days an axis pauses after it is driven back, before it tries again. A design parameter.

pursuitDays.description: Days a pursuit lasts, by the commander’s choice.

returns.description: Casualty returns (0074, 0076): how low the first runs, the captured counted among its missing, and the days until the full return.

works.description: Works dug each night by an axis holding its objective, their cap, and what storming takes off (0029).

people.description: The people core (lane 1.1): history’s shadow, compliance, reading orders and reports, traits. Design parameters the pack states (0072), not sourced facts.

attention.description: The president’s attention (0025, 0040): a weekly cap, its refill, and the cost table (FOUNDATION section 5). Design parameters.

compliance.description: Compliance’s weights and thresholds (M1/M2’s, recast in lane 1.1). Design parameters.

context.description: Oversight for an order read in the chain (the principal’s credibility is politics’ derived term, lane 1.6). Design parameters.

filter.description: The values that make a filter post’s holder hold a wire or cut claims (0032), and the candour at which he cuts nothing.

goalTerms.description: What a goal of each kind asks of the man who reads it: its boldness and the values it honours or offends.

grievances.description: Weights of grievances the people core applies.

relay.description: Days a relaying link holds an order for each covert rung (0040). Design parameters.

shadow.description: History’s shadow (FOUNDATION section 6): how true stats are drawn at setup.

centrePermille.description: The permille centre of each cited direction. A design parameter.

regardPermille.description: Signed regard for each cited direction of regard for the principal. A design parameter.

regardUnknown.description: The regard a man holds toward someone when nothing is known or recorded: toward his principal when uncited, and toward anyone else until play moves it. A design parameter, never a silent 0.

spread.description: Half-width of the uniform draw around a cited centre (0: as history). A design parameter.

unknownCentre.description: The centre of an unknown stat. A design parameter.

unknownSpread.description: Half-width around an unknown centre. A design parameter.

traits.description: How temperament and values shade what a man sees and asks (lane 0.6’s stand-in rules, now the pack’s, 0058).

assaultMargin.description: His demand for an assault on held ground, permille of his demand in the open (the planner applies it, lane 0.9 finding 1).

verbs.description: The people verbs, the ladder, the audience and seat initiatives (lane 1.5). Design parameters.

orderValues.description: The map from orders to values (0074): gate content; a row tagged with gate topics needs the gate reviewer’s sign-off.

practiceWeight.description: What a clash with one of his own practices costs a recipient’s willingness, and adds to the pushback (lane 1.5b).

planner.description: The planner (0062): design parameters the pack states, not sourced facts.

assaultDays.description: Permille days an assault on a garrisoned region takes, on the route as at the objective.

clearDays.description: Permille days to clear works no installation holds (a boom) deliberately.

dailyDraftCap.description: Plans drafted in one day by each side’s commanders; the rest wait for the next, oldest request first. Counted per side: one side’s requests never defer the other’s (0062; lane 0.8 measured the worst day on the Union graph).

dedupeArrival.description: ... and only if they arrive within this many permille days of each other.

dedupeOverlap.description: Candidates sharing at least this many permille of their regions, with the same shape, are duplicates.

dependenceCost.description: What one support request to another holder costs in the score.

flankLengthMax.description: A flank may take at most this many permille of the direct route’s days (0062: 1600).

flankOverlapMax.description: A flank is kept only if it shares fewer than this many permille of the direct route’s regions (0062: 600).

flankPenalty.description: Penalty, permille, on the direct route’s edges when looking for a flank (2000 doubles them).

forceDays.description: Permille days to force such works in a night.

forcingThreat.description: Extra threat, as men, of forcing works or running past batteries.

hopShare.description: Share of a neighbouring region’s perceived enemy that adds to a region’s threat, permille.

maxSearches.description: Route searches allowed per request; the cap is counted and reported, never silent.

menPerDay.description: Men of perceived enemy that weigh as one day’s march in route cost, at risk weight 1000.

partnerRegardWeight.description: Permille of the drafter’s regard for the partner’s holder (signed; regardUnknown with no history) in the cooperation he expects.

partnerStandingPivot.description: The public standing, permille, at which a holder’s reputation neither raises nor lowers what is expected of him.

partnerStandingWeight.description: Permille of the partner holder’s public standing, above or below partnerStandingPivot, in the cooperation expected of him.

partnerWillingnessWeight.description: Permille of the cooperation a drafter expects of a partner holder counted against dependenceCost. He expects it from what he can know: his regard for the holder and the holder’s public standing (0062: beliefs, never truth).

pincerWindow.description: A pincer’s partner may arrive up to this many permille days before the main axis.

reducePerLevel.description: Permille days to reduce works per permille of fortification.

retrogradeSlack.description: An alternative may pass regions at most this many permille days further from the objective than its start.

topN.description: Moving candidates on the menu, plus a holding action (0062: four).

weights.description: How the planner turns a man’s traits into his profile and scores a plan: each score term a signed sum of these weights times the plan’s facts (hard rule 6). Calibrated with compliance.

plans.description: Goals and plans (0040, 0062): design parameters the pack states.

goalDefaults.description: The goal terms an order carries when it names only a posture and an objective (a situation’s option).

holdingRisk.description: A holding action’s riskiness, for reading an edit’s boldness against his own best plan (0062).

politics.description: Politics (lane 1.6): blocs, the chambers and their calendar, credibility, framing and the press. Design parameters and sourced records the pack states (0072).

address.description: An address: the bloc addressed gains support; the side’s blocs sharing none of its values gain othersPenalty.

blocs.description: Blocs with weights and support (FOUNDATION section 7; M2’s blocs recast). A bloc is never a protected group (the gate refuses one).

cite.description: Where its voice, rest and reactions come from (a source key and place, or the design note that sets them).

defeat.description: The same, for a battle reported lost.

id.description: A bloc in the pack’s bloc vocabulary.

rest.description: Its support at the start, and the settled disposition it drifts back toward.

values.description: The values it holds: an address to a bloc costs the side’s blocs that share none of them.

victory.description: Support it moves when its side’s press reports a battle won, at a paper’s full reach.

voice.description: Its share of its side’s voice in Washington; a side’s blocs sum to 1000.

credibility.description: The principal’s sanction credibility (P7), derived: base, a share of his mandate, and each man holding a relief against him, within min..max.

driftDivisor.description: Each week a bloc closes 1/divisor of the gap between its support and its rest.

framing.description: How much the framing term (0028, 0040) counts in the mandate.

ladder.description: A man’s rung, weekly: from lobbying up, his bloc gets lobbyingPerRung per rung; from public defiance, every bloc of his side gets publicDefiance; a rival’s bloc gets rival.

press.description: The press as a report route (FOUNDATION section 7): a weekly front page each paper’s editor writes.

cadenceDays.description: Days between front pages; 0 prints none.

reachPermille.description: The share of its side’s public it reaches; a side’s papers sum to at most 1000.

standing.description: A battle’s commander’s standing moved by a front page reporting it won or lost, at full reach.

sessions.description: The session calendar (0040): regular sessions by their dates, and the special sessions a call may summon.

callable.description: Sits only when a proposal calls it (a special session); otherwise a regular session of the calendar.

closes.description: The last day it sits; for a callable session, null when it sits sitsDays.

opens.description: The first day it sits; for a callable session, null when it meets afterCallDays after the call.

pruning.description: How long ended operations, closed battles and answered orders are kept, in days (lane 1.4; as knowledge prunes). Design parameters.

recruitment.description: Governors raising regiments on a call (lane 1.7): design parameters the pack states. No men stock in 1A: a regiment goes straight into a block.

callTerms.description: How a governor reads a call for regiments: its boldness and the values it honours and offends (pack data; 0074).

loyaltyFull.description: The loyalty to his side at which a governor’s region gives its full share.

loyaltyWeight.description: How far loyalty below that scales the share down (0: loyalty is not read).

maxTermDays.description: The longest enlistment a call may name, in days.

musterBlockedDays.description: Days a levy due to muster waits while its region is enemy-held; past them it lapses, reported to the caller.

musterDays.description: Days from a call’s arrival to muster, for a governor who complies at once.

raisingPostKinds.description: Post kinds whose holders answer a call (a governor’s). A post of a self-governing department never does.

rungs.description: The compliance rungs that raise men: permille of the quota raised and days added to the muster. A rung not listed raises none and sends a memorandum back.

storesDays.description: Days of stores a new block is issued at muster.

reportTemplates.description: One template for every report type and subtype the kernel writes (0032: each a pack-tunable template), with the pruning rule for knowledge (FOUNDATION section 8): design parameters the pack states.

cadenceDays.description: Every this many days, for a report written on a cycle; 0 for one written on an event. A design parameter.

keepSupersededDays.description: A report superseded by a newer one with the same template, author and subject is pruned once this old; at most maxAgeDays. A design parameter.

maxAgeDays.description: A held report older than this is pruned. A design parameter.

templateRoute.description: The usual route; an author off the wire falls back to courier.

templateSubtype.description: The subtype for the informal and advice families; null for every other type.

ruleSeats.description: The generic rule-seat principal (0064): its standing goals stay at hold until its faction is at war, which a situation flag the pack names marks.

warFlags.description: One row per faction in the manifest.

flag.description: The situation chain flag that puts this faction at war; null for war from day 1.

selfEmancipation.description: The derived self-emancipation term (0046; SENSITIVE-HISTORY 3.2): never a lever. Its rates wait on sources; a pack with no census has no arrivals.

agencyReasons.description: The reason type each cause carries, one of the gate register’s agency types (SENSITIVE-HISTORY E3): cause 1 in the enslaving side’s own regions, and elsewhere (a neutral government’s, or the lines’ side’s own); cause 2.

cadenceDays.description: The term is recomputed every this many days.

flightPerMillion.description: Cause 2, flight to the lines, per million of the census per cadence at full reach and policy.

holdShare.description: The control share at which the lines’ side holds a region.

linesFaction.description: The faction whose lines people reach (pack data); null: the pack has no such term.

policyFlags.description: Situation flags that raise or lower known policy, signed permille.

pressureFlags.description: Situation flags whose pressure (impressment, say) raises both causes, permille of each, each with its own agency type (N9).

protectedFlags.description: Where slavery has ended, in law or in fact (G-1.7b; the District of Columbia act of April 1862 is the model): while a flag is set, the term skips its regions. A policy protecting people who reach the lines is a policy flag, which never skips a region; holding a region protects no one by itself.

reachLinesOnly.description: Reach when it holds one with no force there.

reachWithForce.description: Reach when the lines’ side holds the region or a neighbour with its force there.

resistancePerMillion.description: Cause 1, resistance and flight within, keyed to no one’s reach: per million of the census per cadence.

standing.description: Conflicting orders (0040, 0072): a design parameter the pack states, not a sourced fact. A stand-in until the people recast resolves conflicts by compliance.

conflictWindowDays.description: Days within which a chain order stands against a newer order that went around the chain (0040). A design parameter.

stores.description: Stores on hand (0040, 0064): design parameters the pack states, not sourced facts.

capDays.description: The most days of stores a block refills to. A design parameter.

lowDays.description: Stores below this many days are low, a truth event a report may tell; at most capDays. A design parameter.

menPerCapacityUnit.description: Men (and non-combatants) one unit of the capacity scale feeds for a day. A design parameter.

norms.description: Norms for blocks whose stores no source gives (lane 1.4): practice, so each block given one is flagged assumed. First match by post or post kind, arm and side; no match stays unknown.

cavalry.description: Cavalry (lane 1.4): a pursuer with a block of this arm present takes more stragglers.

government.description: A civil government that can hold a region’s jurisdiction (0058): only such a department may be named in a scenario’s governments. The engine reads this, never kind names.

selfGoverning.description: A government of a people who govern themselves (0069): only its own act, a notice, may change its side, close or reopen it, or move its regions, never a principal’s decision. Only a government may be self-governing.

role.description: What the engine reads of this kind (0058): filter (holds or passes what comes in for its principal) or intelligence; null for any other kind. The engine never reads kind names.

rankKinds.description: Kinds of rank held side by side (0073), such as regular, volunteer and brevet.

kind.description: Its kind from rankKinds: a person holds one rank of each kind at once (0073).

values.description: Values people hold (lane 1.1); the engine reads only the people rules that name them.

costOnly.description: 0074: honouring it never helps its holder; offending it still costs.
